newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm to cut unit's temporary workers.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm to cut unit's temporary workers.

text.p: QUALCOMM Inc said late Thursday that its Qualcomm Personal Electronics joint venture with Sony Electronics Inc has reduced its temporary workforce by about 600 people.

The company also said that volume production levels and revenues at the subsidiary are expected to decline as a result of the transition to new phone models and the effect of the off-peak summer season among the industry.

Qualcomm said the job cuts were in response to a planned transition to new product lines, increased efficiencies from automated production methods and lower seasonal demand. The reduction does not affect any of the 1,200-plus regular employees at the subsidiary.
The temporary workers were employed by temporary-employment agenices and were hired to support the initial demand for Code Division Multiple Access phones.

Qualcomm said that temporary employment levels at its subsidiary are expected to continue to vary with seasonal demand and new product introductions. With strong customer demand indicated for new phone models, the unit expects to increase its workforce as production ramps up, the company said.
Qualcomm develops, manufactures, markets, licenses and operates advanced communications systems and products based on digital wireless technologies.
